scripts.install: npm run composer-install && npm run less-setup && npm run frontend-install
scripts.composer-install: echo '[>] Installing PHP dependencies...' && composer install --ignore-platform-reqs && ./vendor/bin/doctrine orm:generate-proxies temp/proxies/
scripts.less-setup: echo '[>] Setup config.less...' && cp js/react/src/less/config_template.less js/react/src/less/config.less && sed -i "s|@subdir: '/'|@subdir: ''|" js/react/src/less/config.less
scripts.frontend-install: echo '[>] Installing frontend dependencies...' && npm -C js/react i
